category: managed Postgres with auth and storage

free_tier.stated: 500 MB database on Shared CPU with 500 MB RAM; 2 active projects; 5 GB egress and 5 GB cached egress; unlimited API requests

retention.stated: a Free project is paused after 1 week of low activity, and is restorable for up to 1 year after the pause. A paid project is never paused
retention.notes: the pause trigger is activity, not age: a few user requests a day over the previous week keep it awake

egress.terms: 5 GB egress and 5 GB cached egress per month included. The Free plan publishes no overage price, so the fifth gigabyte is a wall and not a bill

interface_detail: Postgres wire protocol; a PostgREST data API; a Management API and the Supabase CLI
tooling: psql and any Postgres client; the supabase CLI; PostgREST over HTTP
chaining: a free Postgres plus free auth plus free object storage in one project, which is the whole reason to pick it over a bare Postgres

limits.value: paused after 1 week of low activity; restorable for up to 1 year
2 active projects per account; paused projects do not count against the limit
5 GB egress per month with no published overage path on Free

connections are set by the compute size and not published as a single number; the free plan runs Nano compute with up to 0.5 GB of RAM, and the pooler queues above the direct limit rather than raising it

limits_note: the shared pooler is IPv4-only on every plan; a direct connection is IPv6-only without the paid IPv4 add-on, so an IPv4-only host must use the pooler

identity_cost.detail: email signup; no card on Free

reliability_note: two warning emails precede an automatic pause, one about a week ahead and one on the pause; restore is a dashboard action, not an API call on the free plan
confidence_note: the pricing page and the pausing guide were read today; nothing was provisioned. The 90-day restore window stated in the 2024-06-24 changelog has since been widened to 1 year.

evidence.proved: 500 MB database, 2 active projects, 5 GB egress, 5 GB cached egress, 'Free projects are paused after 1 week of inactivity', and the plan table row Pausing: After 1 week of inactivity
'Supabase pauses Free Plan projects that show low activity over a 7-day period'; restore is available 'for up to 1 year after it was paused'; a few user requests a day over a week prevent it
two free projects across all organizations where you are Owner or Administrator; paused projects do not count toward the free project limit
the 2024-06-24 change set the restore window at 90 days, which the current doc has since widened to 1 year
the shared Supavisor pooler is multi-tenant and IPv4-only; the dedicated PgBouncer pooler needs a paid plan

Nano compute is the free plan at USD 0 with up to 0.5 GB of RAM and a recommended 500 MB database; 'Database max connections are recommended values and can be customized via max_connections', so the compute size sets the count

notes: The pause is the finding, and it is a 7-day activity clock rather than a 30-day deletion. A weekly cron that touches the database keeps it alive; a monthly one loses a week of availability every cycle. The restore window is 1 year, so the data is not at risk the way a deletion would put it at risk.
